title: FCRA Rules Tightened: NGOs Must Spend Min ₹10 Lakh Foreign Funds Over 2 Years for Renewal
summary: Restricts foreign fund usage to predefined categories and bars foreign nationals as key functionaries.

blocks.text: 🪝 FCRA Rules Tightened: NGOs Must Spend Min ₹10 Lakh Foreign Funds Over 2 Years for Renewal. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Restricts foreign fund usage to predefined categories and bars foreign nationals as key functionaries.
Functionary Exclusion: NGOs with foreign nationals (except PIOs) ineligible for FCRA registration without central approval.
Renewal Expenditure: NGOs must spend at least ₹10 lakh foreign funds over past 2 financial years to renew registration.
Utilisation Threshold: Next foreign fund instalment released only after 75% of previous instalment is utilised.
Renewal spend requirement (₹10 lakh over 2 yrs) vs prior permission release threshold (75% utilisation).
